purpose: Structured intake ledger for Daedric runtime/display proof after CAT-6 readback is green.

statusRules.pass: All required slots for a Prince are pass or not_required.
statusRules.conditional: At least one required slot is conditional and no required slot is fail, blocked, or pending.
statusRules.fail: At least one required slot is fail.
statusRules.blocked: At least one required slot is blocked and no required slot is fail.
statusRules.pending: At least one required slot is pending and no required slot is fail or blocked.
